announce.text: Keychain is multichain now. It works on Hive plus Ethereum, Base, BNB Chain, Polygon, Avalanche, Arbitrum and Optimism.
hero.subtitle: It works for Hive and 7 EVM networks, and you can add any other EVM network yourself. Hold and send assets, swap, buy, sign transactions and connect to dApps, on mobile or in your browser. Your keys stay on your device.
